'''Jayn''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Phindian/Legends|Phindian]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He had a [[Starship/Legends|ship]] called ''[[Leilana's Dagger]]'', named after his long-lost love [[Leilana]]. Jayne ultimately met his fate on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Iope]], in the [[Rinn/Legends|Rinn]] system, while his skills were [[Skirmish on Iope|tested]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] [[X-7]]. Soon realizing that no reward was worth attempting to prove himself against X-7's onslaught, Jayn attempted to flee the system. Nonetheless, his ship was disabled and destroyed in the upper atmosphere of the moon. Ironically, Jayn had planned to return to [[Phindar/Legends|Phindar]] and settle-down after collecting his money, like he had always promised Leilana.<ref name="RF4" />
